name: deep_research
description: Launch deep research from one entry that routes to a session-level workflow (light tier) or full V2 loop-engine orchestration (heavy tier) by a documented fan-out scale threshold.

topic.description: The research topic (a single natural-language question or subject).

sources.description: Fan-out scale (number of named research sources). sources < 4 routes to the light tier (session-level workflow.js); sources >= 4 routes to the heavy tier (full V2 orchestration).

tier.description: Explicit tier override; 'auto' uses the documented scale threshold.

profile.description: Deploy profile for the heavy tier (default agent-harness). The heavy tier auto-completes profile selection and channel preparation with zero manual steps.
